name: Diagrams
description: Org charts, flowcharts, timelines and more - from cards, text, Mermaid, DOT or CSV.

featured.blurb: Turn cards or text into on-brand diagrams

inputs.label: Look
inputs.help: Choose a coordinated look, then adjust its cards and connections below. Existing saved diagrams keep Legacy. SVG and PDF keep vector detail; PPTX contains artwork.

inputs.label: Preset
inputs.help: A one-click starting point that seeds the type, theme and spacing. Pick one, then fine-tune anything - your later edits are kept.

inputs.label: Diagram type
inputs.help: Org/Mind map build a tree from each card's parent. Layercake/Kanban group cards by their “Group” ID (stacked bands vs side-by-side columns). Process/Timeline/Cycle lay cards out along flow/order. Pyramid, Matrix and Gantt have their own controls below.

inputs.label: Build from
inputs.help: Pick how you describe the diagram: card rows, plain text, drawn ASCII boxes, Mermaid, DOT, Pikchr or a pasted table. Each text mode reads a subset of that language, and every one of them also takes a dropped file.

inputs.label: Diagram text
inputs.help: Org/Mind map: indent for hierarchy. Layercake/Kanban: “# Group” headings with cards below. Process/Gantt: “A -> B” (Gantt adds “ : 0..3”). Timeline/Cycle/Pyramid: one item per line, in order. Matrix: “# top-right” sections or “Item @ (0.8,0.3)”. Shared: “:: subtitle”, “#hex” fill, “(Rounded)”/“[Box]”/“([Pill])” shape, “@ https://…/logo.png” image, edge styles --> -.-> ==> <->, “// comment”.
inputs.default:
CEO
  CTO :: Technology
    Eng Lead
    QA Lead
  CFO :: Finance
  COO :: Operations

inputs.label: ASCII art
inputs.help: Draw boxes with + - | and connect them with - | and arrowheads > < ^ v. Keep each box's | sides lined up with its +---+ borders. The first line inside a box is its title, the rest its subtitle, and a line of “@ https://…/logo.png” adds an image. Your layout is preserved - we just render it as clean cards.

inputs.label: Mermaid
inputs.help: Paste a Mermaid flowchart or sequenceDiagram subset, or drop a .mmd file. Flowchart: “graph/flowchart TD/LR/BT/RL” sets direction; A[Box], A(Rounded), A([Pill]), A{Diamond} define nodes; A-->B, A---B, A-.->B, A==>B, A-->|label|B, A -- label --> B are edges; chains A-->B-->C and fan-outs A --> B & C work; subgraph Name … end becomes layer bands (nested ones fold into the outermost). Sequence: participants become cards left to right and each message an arrow, so lifelines and timing are approximated, not drawn. Unsupported lines (classDef, click, style, notes, loop/alt…) are skipped, never run.
inputs.default:
graph LR
  A[Client] --> B(API Gateway)
  B --> C[(Database)]
  B -.-> D{{Cache}}

inputs.label: DOT / Graphviz
inputs.help: Paste a Graphviz digraph, or drop a .dot file. “digraph { a -> b }” for directed, “graph { a -- b }” for plain lines; rankdir=LR/TB/RL/BT sets direction; node attributes [label="…", shape=box|ellipse|circle|diamond|cylinder|hexagon|note|plaintext, fillcolor="#hex"] and edge attributes [label="…", style=dashed|dotted|bold, dir=both|none, arrowhead=…] are read; “subgraph cluster_x { label="…" }” becomes a layer band; “node [shape=…]” sets defaults. Node lists (a, b -> c) and chains (a -> b -> c) expand. Anything else is skipped, never run.
inputs.default:
digraph pipeline {
  rankdir=LR
  node [shape=box]
  build [label="Build"]
  test [label="Test", fillcolor="#e8f4f0"]
  ship [label="Ship", shape=cylinder]
  build -> test -> ship
  test -> build [label="fix", style=dashed]
}

inputs.label: Pikchr
inputs.help: Paste a PIC-style Pikchr diagram. Objects flow in a direction: box/circle/ellipse/oval/cylinder/file/dot/line/arrow/move, each with "labels", fill/color, dashed/dotted/thick, wid/ht/rad. Place with from/to/at, compass points (last box.s, .n .e .w .ne …), named objects (Name: box) and ->/<-/<->. Supported subset - macros, [blocks], expressions and splines are skipped, never run.
inputs.default:
arrow right 200% "Source" "input"
box rad 8px "Diagram" "Builder" fill 0xe8f4f0
arrow right 200% "SVG" "output"
arrow <-> down 60% from last box.s
cylinder "Store" fill 0xd0e8e0

inputs.label: Table / CSV
inputs.help: Paste comma- or tab-separated rows, or drop a CSV. Org/Mind map: id,label,detail,parent. Process: from,to,label (an edge list - ids are created automatically). Timeline/Cycle/Pyramid: label,detail. A header row (id/label/from/…) is detected and skipped.
inputs.default:
id,label,parent
ceo,CEO,
cto,CTO,ceo
cfo,CFO,ceo
eng,Eng Lead,cto
qa,QA Lead,cto

inputs.label: Cards
inputs.help: One card per row. In org / mind map, drag a card onto another to nest it - drop above or below to make it a sibling, or onto the middle to make it a child. Elsewhere, drag to reorder (order sets sibling order, layer/column order, and the sequence for timeline/cycle/pyramid/gantt). The ID is an optional short handle.

fields.label: Card colour
fields.help: Overrides the global card fill for this card only.

fields.label: Image
fields.help: Optional headshot, icon, or product logo shown on the card.

fields.label: ID
fields.help: Short unique handle. Auto-derived from the label if left blank.

fields.label: Reports to
fields.help: Org / mind map: the card this one reports to / branches from. Pick a card, or just drag this row onto another in the list.

fields.label: Group
fields.help: Layercake: which band. Kanban: which column - pick one, or type a new name to create a column. Dated Gantt: which swimlane. Cards in the same group sit together.

fields.label: Start
fields.help: Bar start on the time axis. Ignored once this card has a start date.

fields.label: Length
fields.help: Bar length in the same units.

fields.label: Start date
fields.help: yyyy-mm-dd. One dated card turns the whole chart into a dated roadmap: real ticks, swimlanes by Group, and the today line.

fields.label: End date
fields.help: yyyy-mm-dd, inclusive. Blank = a one-day task.

fields.label: Milestone
fields.help: Draw a diamond on the start date instead of a bar.

inputs.notice: Click a card on the canvas to edit it here. Right-click or press and hold for its settings.

inputs.label: Connections
inputs.help: Connect cards or groups by name. Leave colour, head and route at their defaults to follow the look. Click a connection on the canvas to edit this row.

fields.label: Colour
fields.help: Leave empty to inherit the connection colour.

inputs.label: Groups
inputs.help: Each band of the layercake, stacked in this order. Cards reference a band by its ID. (Kanban columns are created automatically from each card's Group ID.)

inputs.label: Theme
inputs.help: Seeds the colours below. Pick one, then override any individual colour.

inputs.label: Card layout
inputs.help: How each card arranges its image and text. Side by side puts the image on the left with left-aligned text - a card with no image uses the full width. Image on top stacks a centred image above centred text.

inputs.label: Focal card
inputs.help: Use equal emphasis for peer relationships. Individual cards can override this in their Emphasis setting.

inputs.label: Surface highlight
inputs.help: The strength of the shallow highlight on Studio cards and objects.

inputs.label: Corner radius
inputs.help: Roundness of “Rounded” cards (Box and Pill keep their shape).

inputs.label: Card border width
inputs.help: 0 = borderless cards.

inputs.label: Label weight
inputs.help: Font weight of the card labels (100 Thin to 900 Black).

inputs.label: Background
inputs.help: Set to Transparent for a knock-out background.

inputs.label: Imported colours
inputs.help: Keep explicit colours from cards and imported sources, or recolour them using the design system.

inputs.label: Reset look
inputs.help: Restore this look’s spacing, colour inheritance and depth. Cards and text are kept.

inputs.label: Arrowhead
inputs.help: Default arrowhead for arrows that don't set their own.

inputs.label: Connectors
inputs.help: Colour of the automatic connectors / spines.

inputs.label: Connection form
inputs.help: Ribbons have a constant width. They do not represent quantities.

inputs.label: Arrow line
inputs.help: Default line style for arrows that don't set their own.

inputs.label: Density
inputs.help: Seeds the spacing + card scale below. Pick one, then nudge the sliders.

inputs.label: Direction
inputs.help: Lay the tree top-to-bottom, or left-to-right for deep hierarchies.

inputs.label: Colour by branch
inputs.help: Tint each top-level branch with its own palette colour.

inputs.label: Flow direction
inputs.help: Which way a process flows between steps.

inputs.label: Curved arrows
inputs.help: Bow the ring arrows outward instead of straight chords.

inputs.label: Style
inputs.help: Cards are listed top to bottom. Pyramid widens downward, funnel narrows, inverted widens upward.

inputs.label: Time unit label
inputs.help: Unitless bars only. Give any card real dates and the axis labels itself.

inputs.label: Time scale
inputs.help: Tick spacing on a dated roadmap. Auto picks it from the span.

inputs.label: Today line
inputs.help: Draws a marker line at this date when it falls inside the roadmap. Empty = off.

inputs.label: Row / layer gap
inputs.help: Spacing along the flow (levels, ranks, bands).

inputs.label: Sibling gap
inputs.help: Spacing between neighbours within a level.

inputs.label: Cards per row
inputs.help: Zero keeps each group on one row. Set a limit to wrap large groups without shrinking their labels.

inputs.label: Canvas padding
inputs.help: Whitespace around the diagram.

inputs.label: Named gradient
inputs.help: Optional design-system token path, for example gradient.brand. Leave empty to use the only gradient token or the two brand accents.

inputs.label: Card scale
inputs.help: Scales card size, padding and text together.

inputs.label: Show reference IDs
inputs.help: IDs connect cards and groups. Keep an existing ID when you rename its label.
